prompts.activity:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is an identity/style reference, not a layout to reproduce. Draw NEW animation frames of only this same adult character.
Output exactly ONE sheet of 20 separate full-body figures in a strict invisible 4-column by 5-row grid, read row-major. Aim at 1536×2304 pixels or the largest supported portrait resolution. Each equal cell contains one complete figure, centered, same camera distance and scale, feet at the same low baseline. Preserve generous transparent gutters and all hair, fingers, props and shoe tips fully inside their own cell. Fixed front three-quarter view, no camera change. Human adult stylized game proportions, not chibi.
Style: refined high-detail Japanese pixel illustration, clean dark pixel contours, carefully clustered highlights, natural anatomical hands, readable face, subtle pixel texture matching the reference. Preserve small fabric folds, seams, buckles, glasses or headphones, jewelry, and high-quality shading. No smooth vector simplification.
Background MUST be genuinely transparent alpha, never a drawn checkerboard. No ground plane, no cast shadow outside the sprite, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no borders, no numbers, no duplicate figures. Exactly 20 original distinct drawings. Consecutive frames must have physically different limb/hand/prop positions with coherent smooth motion; do not repeat, mirror or merely resize a drawing.

Identity: An adult anime woman with a short softly tousled mint-teal bob, green eyes behind round thin dark glasses, gold drop earrings and a small gold pendant necklace, dark teal belted high-neck dress with asymmetric front hem, long cream cardigan with embroidered green botanical patterns, brown tights, brown ankle boots with buckles, narrow brown book satchel strap and small colorful book charms at the left hip. Match the exact reference's facial identity, outfit details, proportions, and pixel palette. Her book has a dark brown cover and warm ivory pages.
Animation ordering: frames 0–9 form one coherent WORKING sequence, frames 10–19 one coherent THINKING sequence. Maintain her prop in every frame. Each following numbered instruction describes its corresponding cell, but DO NOT draw the numbers.
0: open book supported by left hand, right index finds a line
1: right index traces the next line, eyes gaze down through glasses
2: right index pauses at a sentence, body leans slightly inward
3: right hand moves to the upper page corner, elbow lifts
4: right fingers pinch a single page corner, eyes follow
5: one ivory page lifts into a visible curved arc, other pages stay bound
6: turning page halfway across the book, right wrist rotates
7: right hand smooths the newly turned page, shoulders relax
8: right index points to the new paragraph, small attentive smile
9: right hand settles on book edge, head rises slightly from the page
10: book lowered slightly, right hand rises toward her glasses
11: right fingertips adjust glasses bridge, focused gaze
12: right index leaves glasses and approaches chin
13: right index touches chin, eyes look up-left thoughtfully
14: right thumb beneath chin, mild concentrated frown
15: right hand opens beside cheek as she considers an idea
16: right index begins to rise beside her face, gaze brightens
17: right index points up gently, book held close with left arm
18: right hand lowers toward book, head tilts back toward page
19: right fingertips rest on book cover, calm resolved expression

prompts.face:

Asset type: production pixel-art facial animation sheet.
Input image 1 is the exact adult character identity and pixel rendering reference.
Create exactly 18 distinct LARGE HEAD portraits, no full bodies, in an invisible grid of 3 columns and 6 rows, row-major. Portrait canvas about 1024×1536 or highest supported matching 2:3 ratio. Same head position, size, front three-quarter angle and face geometry in every cell; head occupies 80% cell width, entire hair silhouette stays within the cell, generous transparent gutters. Include full head/hair/ears and a short natural neck only; no hands, arms, torso, props or cut-off pieces.
Preserve the reference's mature anime facial features, pixel-contour detail, iris highlights, hair highlights, earrings and face accessories. Do not simplify to chibi, smooth vector or a different person. Genuine transparent alpha background, no drawn checkerboard, no labels/numbers/grid/shadows/watermarks.
Exact row-major expressions:
0 neutral lips closed; 1 slightly parted lips; 2 speaking A with vertically open mouth; 3 speaking O with rounded mouth; 4 speaking E broad mid-open mouth; 5 speaking I narrow horizontally stretched mouth; 6 speaking U small pursed round lips; 7 warm smile while speaking with visible open smiling mouth;
8 blink start eyes fully open; 9 eyes one-quarter closed; 10 eyes half closed; 11 eyes three-quarter closed; 12 eyes fully closed with relaxed eyelids; 13 eyes reopening, one-third open;
14 gentle pleased smile eyes open; 15 concern with knit brows and small worried mouth; 16 concentrated focused gaze with firm brows and closed mouth; 17 surprise with raised eyebrows, wide eyes and small open mouth.
Keep head registration consistent. All 18 must be uniquely drawn and visibly express their specified mouth/eyelid/emotion state; do not add any extra portraits.
